about: drawn after Unitree's product pictures of the Dex1-1 (unitree.com/Dex1-1 and the reseller copies of them: the only sharp views of every component) and after footage of the real gripper on the G1 (a factory clip, a lab clip, wrist-camera frames), 2026-11-12: a gripper black all over but for its two guide rails: the pebbled matt motor can, the satin block with its two carriages, the black-oxide pinion, the matt black alloy jaws (the Library's part: one mesh holding the jaw, its rubber pad, the UNITREE cover strip, the rack, the guide rail and the rail's end stop, so all of it wears the jaw's black).  A correction to the words above: the base link holds no rail; each finger's mesh holds its own guide rail and rack, which travel with the jaw, and the base link holds the two carriages and the pinion.  The bright steel is the project's own drawing, not the model's: on each finger plain boxes just proud of the rail and of the rack's body under it, with the rail's groove as a step (bodies/unitree-dex1/drawn-rail-sensor.stl and drawn-rail-mate.stl; the product pictures show both as one ground steel bar with dark teeth, which stay the mesh's), and the two black cap screws of the rail that stand outside the block at full opening, as plain discs over the mesh's counterbores, and with them a small black plate behind the one screw hole of the cover strip that stands outside the block, so that the drawn steel does not shine through the hole (drawn-rail-screws-sensor.stl, drawn-rail-screws-mate.stl).  Not modelled: every other screw (the meshes keep their holes), the pad's knurl and its rubber as a look of its own, the camera ring's bracket, the cable.

jaw-black.evidence: the three-quarter product picture and the wrist-camera frames of the real jaws: a matt black with a fine texture and no sharp highlight (#2c2c2e on a lit face), flatter than the block's satin; less metal and more of the room than the base, because a black's faces turned from the lights take only the room's diffuse light: with metalness 0.4 and 2.3 the jaw's broad side at the Exploded view turned 180 degrees read #15171d, the film's own colour beside it; with these numbers #1e1f25 to #282a2f there and #494a4d at the home

can-black.evidence: the three-quarter product picture: the motor can is pebbled matt, a lighter and bluer black than the block (#545862 lit and #343439 in its middle against the block's #252529 front) under one broad soft highlight; with the base's metalness and room the can mirrored a dark flag at the home, #1b1d23 against the film's #222327, and its shaded side at the Exploded view turned 180 degrees read #1e2025; with these numbers #24252b and #25272c, under a #56575b lit side at the home

block-black.evidence: the hero and the three-quarter product pictures: the block and the carriage in it are satin black, #252529 on the front under a #706f74 top; with the base look the block's broad face turned from the lights at the Exploded view turned 180 degrees read #0e1016, and with metalness 0.5 and 2.8 still #16181e, the film's own colour (#15171d); less metal and more of the room, as for the jaw: #26282c there, #3b3c40 at the home, #9b9c9e to #9e9fa1 where the face mirrors a softbox (the views turned 270 degrees)

oxide-black.evidence: the three-quarter product picture: the pinion is black-oxide steel, #3a3a3e, with small sharp highlights on its teeth

rail-steel.evidence: the hero, the three-quarter and the Advanced version's product pictures and the lab clip's top view: the rails are ground bright steel, #c9c9c9 on the end face, the long faces between a #1f2024 reflection and a #b2b3b8 highlight, with the wide soft highlight of a ground face: lighter than the base's zinc grey.  Only part metal in the stage, so that a face shows the room's diffuse light beside what it mirrors: the rail's screw face mirrors a softbox at the views turned 270 degrees and a dim wall at the home, and as an all-metal look (#c8c9cc, roughness 0.4, 1.1) it was the card's own #f5f5f7 at the first (5.4 % of the opaque solids at 240 or more in the Assembled view and 5.3 % in the Exploded one, measured on a green card so that a solid of the card's colour is counted), and all metal and dark enough for that side (the base's colour, roughness 0.55, 0.8) a dull #727577 at the home; with these numbers #d3d4d8 to #d9dbdf at that side, nothing at 240 or more at any of the eight views looked at, and #919396 under a #cacbce top at the home

screw-black.evidence: the hero and the three-quarter product pictures: each cap screw of a rail is a dark disc in its counterbore from every side, #222228 to #46474c, with a highlight on the head's rim alone; a disc in the pinion's black-oxide look mirrored the key and read #99999c on the lit rail at the turned views, now #535356 to #5d5d60
